Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final analysis step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly stated that Stewart Raffill was born in 1932. The WebSurfer's previous turn (Step 9) explicitly provided the metadata from the Wikipedia page showing the headline "British writer and director (born 1942)" and the JSON LD context also indicated "born 1942". The Planner hallucinated the year 1932 instead of reading the correct year 1942 from the provided evidence. This error led to the wrong conclusion that Lost in Africa's director was born earlier (1932 < 1939), whereas the correct comparison (1942 > 1939) means Buffet Froid's director was born earlier.
